# NetBird v0.76.1

> Documentation generated from the latest stable release of [netbirdio/netbird](https://github.com/netbirdio/netbird) and pinned to immutable source commit `0780a806f2cc2e8a6a51782cfffe0591b7c3fa9c`.

- [Full documentation](llms-full.txt): Complete normalized corpus for NetBird v0.76.1.
- [Provenance manifest](manifest.json): Release, commit, document count, and generation notes.
- Public docs are pinned to netbirdio/docs commit 14375a092774f250d45a85f6d5f3c524d99fd111; its commit message matches v0.76.1 and it changes generated API resource pages.
- NetBird does not tag its public docs repository; non-API pages are an evergreen snapshot at that exact commit, not a formally versioned manual.
- Release-tagged technical architecture documents are included separately from the public documentation snapshot.
